title: Models
empty: No model service is connected yet: Cobble answers with the built-in demo model “{{model}}”, which only replays recorded conversations. Connect a service below to build real projects.

form.keyHelp: Kept encrypted on this machine. It is sent once and never shown again.

working: Connecting… the model gateway restarts, this takes about 20 seconds.

test.auth_failed: refused the key. Check that it is correct and has not expired.
test.model_not_found: does not know this model name. Check the spelling.
test.rate_limited: refused because of a limit or a missing balance on your account.
test.unreachable: cannot be reached. Check the address and the network.

removeDescription: The key is deleted from this machine. Projects keep their history.
removeDefault: This is the model used by default: Cobble goes back to the built-in demo model until you choose another. The key is deleted from this machine.
